provenance.evidence: The official overseas ticket page states that Lawson tickets become available at 10:00 JST on the 10th of each month for admission during the subsequent calendar month.

The official park-ticket page states that tickets are sold daily from 14:00 for admission on the same date two months later; if that same admission date does not exist, sales begin at 14:00 on the first day of the next month. It also states that sales may be suspended when the daily ticket sales limit is reached.

The official park-ticket page states that tickets are sold daily from 14:00 for admission on the same date two months later; if that same admission date does not exist, sales begin at 14:00 on the first day of the next month. It also states that sales may be suspended when the daily ticket sales limit is reached.

The official Katsura Imperial Villa guidelines state that online advance applications are accepted from 05:00 on the first day of the month three months before the preferred visit date until 23:59 three days before that date; if applications exceed allocated capacity, a lottery is conducted.
The official 2027 Grand Tournament schedule lists the Osaka March tournament at EDION Arena Osaka from 2027-03-14 through 2027-03-28 and states that advance tickets are sold from 2027-02-06.

Primary official source https://museum-tickets.nintendo.com/en states that tickets are first sold to drawing entrants and gives the example that a July 15 visit may enter the drawing from April 1 through April 30. Supporting official calendar https://museum-tickets.nintendo.com/en/calendar?lang=en states that drawings occur once per month and, on 2026-09-13, shows December 2026 drawing entries open through September 30 at 23:59. Nihon therefore records the full calendar month three months before the visit month as an official-derived drawing application window, without generalizing the one observed 23:59 close into a recurring clock time.

provenance.sourceEntity: PokéPark KANTO Official Web Ticket Store — outside-Japan purchase
provenance.evidence: The official English PokéPark KANTO ticket information directs guests residing outside Japan to the Official Web Ticket Store. The store states that admission tickets use an Application system for admission three months in advance, with applications accepted from the 1st through the 12th of each month; ticket sales and Application periods start at 8:00 PM JST; and lottery redraws may occur for unsuccessful applicants when tickets become available. Nihon records only this outside-Japan application window and does not encode the separate Japan-resident first-come path. Supporting official residence-routing source rechecked 2026-09-14: https://www.pokepark-kanto.co.jp/ppark/ticketInfo/type/index?languageKind=en_US.
